steps.name: spawn
steps.lua: assert(not udg_AiControl[ScenarioSlot], 'slot already controlled'); createAiPlayer(ScenarioSlot, ScenarioToken); return 'spawned'

steps.name: workers
steps.lua: assert(AiRaceOf(ScenarioSlot)~=nil, 'race missing'); assert(udg_Ai_harvest[ScenarioSlot]~=nil and BlzGroupGetSize(udg_Ai_harvest[ScenarioSlot])>0, 'no harvesters'); return 'workers'

steps.name: army
steps.lua: assert(udg_Ai_army[ScenarioSlot]~=nil and BlzGroupGetSize(udg_Ai_army[ScenarioSlot])>0, 'army has not grown'); return 'army'
